Contribution type
* Please switch the contribution type to clash of code.

Goal
* Please shorten the statement to the following:

An automated rail yard contains [[N]] switches, numbered {{1}} to [[N]]. Each switch is initially set to {{L}} (Left) or {{R}} (Right) and has a target for each direction. A target is either another switch, or a terminal depot with an identifier that is not a switch number.

• All trains are dispatched sequentially.
• Each train starts at switch {{1}}.
• When a train enters a switch, it follows the target indicated by the switch's current direction, then the switch toggles to the opposite direction.
• The new direction applies to the subsequent train that enters the switch.
• A train stops when it reaches a terminal depot.

Given the initial switch states and track layout, determine the terminal depot reached by each train.

Input
* Please provide a description for each of the following variables, with each on a separate line:
  • id
  • initialState
  • leftTarget
  • rightTarget

  For consistency across sections, please use the terms "switch number" and "terminal depot identifier" instead of "switch identifier" or "terminal depot number" in the descriptions.

Constraints
* Please change both 50 and 100 to 10, as neither [[N]] nor [[T]] ever exceeds 10.

* Please add the following constraints immediately before the final existing constraint:
1 ≤ [[id]] ≤ [[N]]
1 ≤ length of [[leftTarget]], length of [[rightTarget]] ≤ 9

* Please add "meaning that a train never visits the same switch more than once" to the final existing constraint.

* Please add the following as the final constraint:
Every train eventually reaches a terminal depot.

Stub generator
* Line 3: Please change both 15 to 9.

* Line 12: Please change "identifier" to "number".

* Lines 14 & 15: Please change "node" to "target".

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases in which both [[N]] and [[T]] equal to 10, and most targets are switches rather than terminal depots. Both left-target and right-target connections to other switches should appear in each case.

Thanks.

Goal
* For clarity, please replace "All trains are dispatched sequentially" with "Each train completes its journey before the next train is dispatched."

Constraints
* Please insert the following as the 5th constraint:
[[leftTarget]] and [[rightTarget]] contain non-space characters only.

Game modes
* It could be too difficult to infer the task from the visible cases alone in Reverse mode.

Thanks.
